name: Bed Out
source:
In Bed Out, the roots are a metaphor for depression, which sap Miguel of his energies and leave him in a constant state of despondency. On the recommendation of his psychologist, he starts his healing process from changes in his daily routine, starting to make decisions and attitudes that change his current way of living.

[Translated from [url=https://cheesaki.itch.io/bed-out]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Bed Out》中，根源是抑郁症的隐喻，抑郁症耗尽了米格尔的精力，让他处于持续的沮丧状态。在心理学家的建议下，他从改变日常生活开始开始治疗过程，开始做出改变他目前生活方式的决定和态度。

[译自[url=https://cheesaki.itch.io/bed-out]Itch.io[/url]]
